desc:
Create car crashes similar to the ones you see on Youtube.

Slots should save automatically if you leave without saving manually, but please do not rely solely on autosaves.

If you've ever used ROBLOX Studio or F3X Tools, then you might have an easier time playing this game. 

Because this is in Alpha, there are some features planned that I haven't added yet  (including Gamepass Vehicles), and the game can be very buggy at times.
